PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.CONTROLLER_HEADING: Who is responsible for your data
PRIVACY.CONTROLLER_BODY: The data controller is Peter Ciprian Olah, operator of StrollBar. StrollBar is an independent service for discovering and playing story-led walking strolls. The controller's contact details are available in the imprint.
PRIVACY.SCOPE_BODY: This policy explains how StrollBar processes personal data when you browse public strolls, create an account, use an authenticated adventure, submit content or reports, or contact the operator. It applies to the StrollBar website and API.
PRIVACY.DATA_BODY: Depending on how you use the service, this may include your username, email address, profile image, password hash, authentication and session data, stroll progress, answers, reviews, reports, achievements, uploaded media, and technical request data such as timestamps, IP address, user-agent, and error or audit records. We do not store passwords in readable form.
PRIVACY.PURPOSE_BODY: We use personal data to create and manage accounts, authenticate users, provide stroll, progress, review, achievement, media, and reporting features, send requested account or verification messages, prevent misuse, maintain security, troubleshoot failures, and respond to requests.
PRIVACY.BASES_BODY: We process data where necessary to perform our contract with you, including providing the account and requested features; to comply with legal obligations; for our legitimate interests in securing, operating, and improving the service, where those interests do not override your rights; and, where required, on the basis of your consent, such as for optional preference or analytics storage. You can withdraw consent at any time through Cookie settings; this does not affect prior processing.
PRIVACY.SHARING_BODY: We do not sell personal data. We share data only when needed to operate StrollBar, comply with law, protect rights and security, or when you choose an integration. Depending on deployment, providers may include database hosting, media storage, web application hosting, email delivery, and social-login providers. Providers process data under contracts or terms applicable to their service and only for the relevant purpose.
PRIVACY.TRANSFERS_BODY: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where this happens, we use a lawful transfer mechanism required by the GDPR, such as an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards including Standard Contractual Clauses, together with supplementary measures where necessary. Ask the controller for information about the safeguards applicable to a particular provider.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_BODY: StrollBar uses necessary browser storage and cookies for authentication, security, session and consent management. Optional preference and analytics storage is disabled unless you consent through the cookie banner. You can change or withdraw optional choices using Cookie settings. Blocking necessary storage may prevent login or core features from working.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY: We retain account, content, and progress information while your account is active or while it is needed to provide the service, resolve disputes, enforce terms, or meet legal obligations. Security, audit, and consent records are kept only for as long as reasonably necessary for their purpose. When data is no longer needed, we delete it or anonymize it where reasonably practicable. We use hashed passwords, signed tokens, access controls, and encrypted transport, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_BODY: Subject to the GDPR and applicable law, you may request access to your personal data, correction of inaccurate data, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country, including the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH). Requests can be submitted through the controller's GitHub contact channel; we may need to verify your identity.
PRIVACY.CHILDREN_BODY: StrollBar is not directed to children who cannot lawfully consent to personal-data processing under the law applicable to them. If you believe a child has provided personal data without appropriate consent, contact the controller so it can be reviewed and deleted where required.
PRIVACY.AUTOMATED_BODY: We do not make decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects about you solely by automated processing, and we do not use your data for profiling that has such effects.
PRIVACY.SECURITY_BODY: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures appropriate to the risk, including access controls, password hashing, signed authentication tokens, encrypted transport, backups, and monitoring of relevant service events. If a personal-data breach creates a risk to individuals, we will handle it as required by applicable law.
PRIVACY.CHANGES_BODY: We may update this policy when the service, providers, or legal requirements change. The current version and its effective date will be published on this page. If a change materially affects your rights, we will provide an additional notice where required.
PRIVACY.CONTACT_BODY: For privacy requests and questions, contact Peter Ciprian through the contact details provided in the imprint. Do not include unnecessary sensitive data in a public report; request a private contact channel instead.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of Service
TERMS.SERVICE_BODY: StrollBar provides a digital platform for discovering and playing story-led walking strolls. Features may change as the project develops.
TERMS.ACCOUNTS_BODY: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials private and for activity performed through your account. Provide accurate information and notify the operator if you believe your account has been compromised.
TERMS.CONTENT_BODY: Stroll descriptions, riddles, media, and other materials are provided for entertainment and orientation. Check local conditions, opening hours, traffic, weather, and accessibility before starting a stroll.
TERMS.ACCEPTABLE_USE_BODY: Do not misuse the service, bypass authentication, interfere with its operation, upload unlawful or harmful content, or use it in a way that puts yourself or others at risk.
TERMS.AVAILABILITY_BODY: The service is provided on an as-available basis. The operator is not responsible for interruption, inaccurate third-party information, route hazards, or decisions made while following a stroll. Use reasonable care and follow local rules.
TERMS.CHANGES_BODY: These terms may be updated as the service changes. The latest version will be published on this page, with the update date shown above. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
